clue.text: Syndicate's caution about time taken by learner

indicators.note: about means the word for caution goes around the next piece

parts.note: care is caution
L is the learner driver's plate

explanation.surface: A cartel's warning about the time a trainee takes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' puts CARE around T, giving CARTE; L follows.
explanation.definitionFit: A cartel is a syndicate of firms acting together to fix prices or output.

clue.text: Workshops re-let, as I planned

indicators.note: planned says these letters are set out afresh in a new design

explanation.surface: Someone explains that the workshops were re-let according to their plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'planned' rearranges RELET plus ASI.
explanation.definitionFit: Ateliers are artists' or craftworkers' studios, a kind of workshop.

clue.text: Floods coming from fissures beneath hill

indicators.note: in a down clue, beneath places the fissures below the hill

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
rents are tears or splits

explanation.surface: Water pouring out of cracks at the foot of a hill.
explanation.definitionFit: Torrents are violent rushing streams, i.e. floods of water.

clue.text: Despicable bloke trapping stray cats is a hopeless case

indicators.note: trapping means the bloke holds the other letters inside him

parts.note: a louse is a contemptible man

indicators.note: stray says the letters of cats wander out of order

explanation.surface: A nasty man catching stray cats seems a hopeless endeavour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Despicable bloke' is one unit: LOUSE as an insult for a contemptible man.
explanation.definitionFit: A lost cause is an undertaking with no chance of success, a hopeless case.

clue.text: Wave from puny adult — hates all getting undressed!

indicators.note: getting undressed strips each of the three words of its outer letters, leaving their insides

explanation.surface: A feeble grown-up waves while everyone hates having their clothes removed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'all' says every word is stripped: UN, DUL and ATE remain.
explanation.definitionFit: To undulate is to move in a wave-like rising and falling motion.

clue.text: Sick of alternative theatre when rude

indicators.note: alternative says these letters take a different arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone is fed up with fringe theatre whenever it turns crude.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sick of' looks like one phrase, but 'Sick' alone is the definition and 'alternative' rearranges THEATRE plus WHENRUDE.
explanation.definitionFit: Feeling unwell or poorly is the idiomatic meaning of being out of sorts in this phrase.

clue.text: Improvement in golf technique?

definitions.meaning: a rise or upturn in fortunes
whimsically, a way of swinging the club upwards

explanation.surface: Getting better at golf by working on how you strike the ball.
explanation.definitionFit: An upswing is an upturn or improvement; read as two words it is a swing going up.

clue.text: A prisoner going in with a snake

indicators.note: going in means the first two pieces enter the later phrase

parts.note: with gives and
con is short for convict

explanation.surface: An inmate is locked up alongside a snake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going in' puts ACON inside ANDA (with, a).
explanation.definitionFit: The anaconda is a huge South American constricting snake.

clue.text: Snarl, seeing approach after gent loses head

indicators.note: after places the word for approach behind the shortened man
loses head drops the first letter of the word gent

parts.note: an angle is a way of approaching a subject

explanation.surface: A snarl from a man who has lost his temper, in a confrontation.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Snarl' suggests growling, but here it is the verb meaning to tangle.
explanation.definitionFit: To snarl, in the sense of tangling threads or traffic, is to entangle.

clue.text: Repeated, looking embarrassed about force

indicators.note: about means the colour word wraps around the forcing word

parts.note: red-faced, so red
to prise is to force open

explanation.surface: Someone blushes when an earlier use of force comes up again.
explanation.walkthrough: 'looking' is a link: looking embarrassed is simply red.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprise a song or role is to perform it again, to repeat it.

clue.text: A second worker crosses line at an angle

parts.note: the ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: A deputy labourer cuts across a line diagonally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crosses' puts L inside ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Aslant means slanting or oblique, lying across at an angle.

clue.text: Muffler acquired by nieces playing around lake and river

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters surround the next one
playing says the letters of nieces are messing about into a new order

parts.note: L is the map abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Nieces playing by a lake and river get hold of a scarf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'playing' turns NIECES into SIENCE; 'around' puts L inside to give SILENCE, then R.
explanation.definitionFit: A silencer muffles noise, as on a gun or exhaust, so it is a muffler.

clue.text: Refuse to acknowledge one's surrounded by drink

indicators.note: surrounded by means the word for drink encloses the previous piece

parts.note: to down a pint is to drink it
one is I, and 's gives IS

explanation.surface: Someone refuses to own up when surrounded by alcohol.
explanation.walkthrough: 'drink' is the verb here, as in to down a glass.
explanation.definitionFit: To disown a person or act is to deny any connection with it, refusing to accept it.

clue.text: Making contact — how sweet!

definitions.meaning: physically meeting or pressing against something
an exclamation at something moving or heart-warming

explanation.surface: A tender moment of physical contact draws a fond sigh.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both in contact and emotionally affecting, prompting an exclamation of sweetness.

clue.text: Story of arrival in state

indicators.note: in places the abbreviation inside the word for state

parts.note: a nation is a state
arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrival

explanation.surface: A tale of someone coming to a country.
explanation.definitionFit: A narration is an account or telling of events, a story.

clue.text: Thinks, having dismissed first of many applications

indicators.note: having dismissed means a letter is sent away from the thinking word

parts.note: muses means ponders or thinks

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of many

explanation.surface: Someone ponders after rejecting the first of numerous job applications.
explanation.walkthrough: MUSES loses M, the first letter of 'many'.
explanation.definitionFit: Uses are purposes or applications to which something is put.

clue.text: Nouveau-riche people at university — with introductions

parts.note: being up means in residence at university, as at Oxford
starts are beginnings or openings

explanation.surface: Newly rich students arrive at university with connections.
explanation.definitionFit: Upstarts are people who have risen suddenly in wealth or rank and behave arrogantly.

clue.text: Part of banquet here — almost heavenly

indicators.note: Part of says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A feast here is nearly divine.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethereal means delicate and otherworldly, as if from the heavens.

clue.text: Overseas earnings holding facility

indicators.note: holding says the words contain the answer within them

explanation.surface: Foreign income is kept in a financial facility.
explanation.definitionFit: Facility can mean effortlessness or ease, as in doing something with facility.

clue.text: Prestigious encounters in river on the rise

indicators.note: in a down clue, on the rise means the whole lot is read upwards
in places the encounters inside the river name

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Wales, Chester and Scotland
meets means encounters

explanation.surface: Distinguished meetings take place on a river, going upstream.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on the rise' reads the built word from the bottom up.
explanation.definitionFit: Esteemed means highly regarded or respected, which is to be prestigious.

clue.text: Local landowner's gripping runs with large animal

indicators.note: gripping means the landowner holds the next letter inside

parts.note: a squire is a country landowner
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A country squire grabs a big animal as it runs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gripping' puts R inside SQUIRE, then L follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The squirrel is a bushy-tailed rodent, an example of an animal.

clue.text: Labour's chasing after tax, tries to improve contacts

indicators.note: chasing places the word for labour behind the tax word

parts.note: net pay is what is left after tax
works means labour or toil

explanation.surface: The Labour party pursues tax policy while seeking to widen its contacts.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Labour' looks like the political party; here it simply means work.
explanation.definitionFit: To network is to cultivate useful professional connections.

clue.text: Show agreement, but changed to underpin love? Indisputably

indicators.note: in a down clue, to underpin places the rearranged letters below the zero

parts.note: to nod is to show agreement
love is zero in tennis, so O

indicators.note: changed says the letters of but are altered in order

explanation.surface: Someone nods along, but changes to support love, beyond question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' turns BUT into UBT, which goes beneath O.
explanation.definitionFit: Without question or certainly; the phrase means beyond dispute.

clue.text: Attempt to cover rear with it?

indicators.note: to cover means the attempt word wraps around the rear

parts.note: a try is an attempt
the end is the rear part

explanation.surface: Wearing a fashionable cover over one's backside.
explanation.walkthrough: The rugby sense of 'try' is a red herring; it is just an attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: Being with it means fashionable and up to date, which is trendy.

clue.text: Drivers crossing Cape planned to go west for scholarly life

indicators.note: crossing means the drivers straddle the cape letter

parts.note: the AA is Britain's Automobile Association, a motoring organisation
C is the map abbreviation for cape

indicators.note: in an across clue, to go west means to read leftwards, backwards

parts.note: aimed means intended or planned

explanation.surface: Motorists heading round a headland plan a westward trip in search of learning.
explanation.walkthrough: The AA is Britain's Automobile Association, so 'Drivers' are its members; 'to go west' reverses in an across clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Academia is the world of universities, research and scholarship.

clue.text: He's trapped in crush lacking protection for primate

indicators.note: trapped in means the first piece is held inside the shortened word
lacking protection strips away the outer letters that guard the word crush

explanation.surface: A man stuck in a crowd without a guard, like an ape.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'protection' is the outer pair of letters, shielding the inside of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: The rhesus macaque is an Asian monkey, a primate.

clue.text: Prayer left mother in dangerous environment

indicators.note: environment means the risky word surrounds the other pieces

parts.note: hairy is slang for frightening or dangerous
ma is mother

explanation.surface: A mother abandoned somewhere perilous says a prayer.
explanation.walkthrough: LMA goes inside HAIRY.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hail Mary is a Catholic prayer to the Virgin; also a last desperate throw.

clue.text: Small dish needed for spread

parts.note: a platter is a large serving dish

explanation.surface: A little plate is wanted to hold the food spread.
explanation.definitionFit: To splatter is to splash or scatter something in drops, spreading it messily.

clue.text: Head professor retiring, led out

indicators.note: retiring means the academic goes backwards

parts.note: a don is a university teacher

indicators.note: out says the letters of led are disordered

explanation.surface: A senior professor retires and is led away.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' reverses DON; 'out' rearranges LED to DLE.
explanation.definitionFit: Noddle is old informal slang for the head or brain.
